jobs.description: In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Partner with Product Management and key stakeholders to understand product vision, customer needs, business objectives, and roadmap priorities, translating them into actionable direction for development teams. Support Program Increment (PI) planning activities by refining features and user stories, identifying dependencies and risks, and contributing to meaningful business outcomes. Manage and continuously refine the team backlog to balance customer value, business priorities, technical requirements, quality improvements, and team capacity. Develop clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting requirements that enable effective and efficient software delivery. Help teams understand the customer impact and business value behind planned functionality, enabling informed prioritization and decision-making. Gather and incorporate customer and stakeholder feedback to enhance usability, reliability, and overall product experience. Collaborate across development, quality, architecture, operations, and security teams to coordinate work, address dependencies, and support successful delivery outcomes.
